title: Inside the Playwright Container: What's in Microsoft's Browser Image and How to Run It in Production
description: A teardown of mcr.microsoft.com/playwright: layers, browsers, fonts, tags and the flags that matter. Then five real ways to use it, from one-shot screenshot jobs to a shared browser server, sharded CI and synthetic monitoring.

title: Journey to Cloud: Modernizing 60+ Legacy Java Apps, from WebSphere to Kubernetes
description: Mavenizing 60+ legacy apps, a reusable Jenkins pipeline, WebSphere to Liberty, Docker and AKS, and saving on database licensing. Then one intranet-heavy app hit a latency wall and moved to on-prem OpenShift while the rest stayed in the cloud. Plus what I'd do differently today.

title: Streaming Logs from Strimzi Kafka into OpenSearch with Data Prepper
description: Run Kafka on Kubernetes with Strimzi, push application logs into a topic, and ship them to OpenSearch with a Data Prepper pipeline.
